text.aria-label: Title text 'The LR_b20 mask recovers at least half of the oracle's gain after 6 of 34 load shifts and nothing after 22'

after 6 of 34 load shifts and nothing after 22

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One dot per labelled real load shift lasting over 1 day (34 of the 35 have readings after them). Gain is the K0 score minus the arm's score, averaged over the rows in the 72 hours after the load shift ends, in points (1 point is 1% of the substation's effective capacity). ORACLE is the mask over the logged load shifts.'
text.tspan: One dot per labelled real load shift lasting over 1 day (34 of the 35 have readings after them). Gain is the K0
score minus the arm's score, averaged over the rows in the 72 hours after the load shift ends, in points (1 point
is 1% of the substation's effective capacity). ORACLE is the mask over the logged load shifts.
